read.description: The mark of the change as it was read: eight characters, each a digit or a letter from a to f, in quotes.

name.description: The fault, as one sentence that reads alone: one line of 1 to 100 characters. No remedy and no word of severity.

severity.description: `block`: the point must be answered before the reading can end. `note`: nobody must answer it, and nothing waits for it.

about.description: Where to look: one to three addresses, the nearest first, none twice. A record is `folder/id`, a step of a flow `flows/<id>#<step>`, the need the word `need`.

finding.description: One fault, in 1 to 500 characters: what the records say, by their ids, and what goes wrong for whom. No remedy.

recommendation.description: What must be true of the change for the point to close, in 1 to 300 characters; or a question for the person. An outcome, not a design. May be left out on a note.

status.description: Where the point stands. Left out, it is `open`. The corrector sets `fixed` or `declined`; the reviewer, at the second reading, `closed` or `reopened`. `settled`: the person said how a declined or reopened point ends, and their word is its next comment.

comments.description: One line of 1 to 300 characters added at each change of status, by who changes it. No line is rewritten or taken out.

points.description: The points, each under its id, the weightiest first. Left out when nothing is found.

description: The review of a change, in a file named by the change's id: the mark of the change as it was read, and the points that the reader found.
